column2: Is a vassal of the Jade Viceroy

Your [invasion_of_cathay_claimant.GetRootRelation], §Y[invasion_of_cathay_claimant.GetBestName]§!, will become the new §Y[invasion_of_cathay_claimant.GetEmperorEmpress] of Cathay§!. Any of their immediate family who are not landed or the primary heir to a title will join them in the Celestial Empire.\nAny land held by the Jade Viceroy will be transferred to you.
